needsVsWants.title: Needs vs Wants
needsVsWants.description: Learn how to identify essential expenses and optional spending.

needs.title: Needs
needs.description: Things that are essential for daily life, education, or basic responsibilities.

wants.title: Wants
wants.description: Things that are optional and can be delayed or avoided when necessary.

questions.feedback: Correct! Basic food is an essential requirement.
Correct! A video game is optional and can usually be delayed.
Correct! Required transportation can be an essential expense.

questions.item: Buying expensive clothes when you already have enough
questions.feedback: Correct! Buying extra clothes when they are not needed is generally a want.
Correct! Required study materials support education.

questions.item: Going to the cinema for entertainment
Paying for basic internet needed for studies
questions.feedback: Correct! Internet may be a necessary expense when it is required for education.

questions.item: Buying the latest phone when your current phone works
questions.feedback: Correct! An unnecessary upgrade is generally a want.

decisionGuide.question: Is this essential for daily life or an important responsibility?
Can I live without buying this right now?
decisionGuide.ifNo: Consider whether it is an essential expense.

decisionGuide.question: Can I delay this purchase?
decisionGuide.ifNo: Check whether it is genuinely necessary.

generalFeedback.correct: Great job! You correctly identified the category.
generalFeedback.incorrect: Not quite. Think about whether the item is essential or optional before deciding.
